name: Mera
description: Hero that can switch between a sword and a sidearm. Attacking units with her sword grants her temporary attack speed. Can dash through enemies and create an armor field around her.

abilities.name: Kinetic Dash
abilities.description:
Dashes forward, dealing her attack damage to enemies in path.
Recharges shields equal to {shieldpercent}% of damage dealt.

abilities.name: Bulwark Field
abilities.description: Nearby friendly units gain {shields} shields for {duration} seconds.

abilities.name: Weapon Switch
abilities.description: Mera switches between ranged and melee weapons.
abilities.details:
Valora: Melee Weapon with splash damage and grants {speed}% attack speed on attack for {asdur}s.
Pulse Pistol: Ranged weapon which slows enemies by {slow}% for {slowdur}s.
